subject: Post-demo: Arcadia - access export & evidence delivery plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Carter <lindsey.carter@arcadia-fin.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@arcadia-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo recap + who-accessed export request (next steps)

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning — appreciate you and Tom walking through your compliance checklist. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get you the sample audit exports you asked for: 

- What we covered: hosted inference call flow, who-accessed/"who did what when" telemetry, encryption at-rest/in-transit, and region isolation options.
- Action requested (from Arcadia): a 7-day sample of "access events" for a representative service account and a user account, plus a sanitized sample of prompt/response fields or hashed equivalents so your internal privacy team can validate redaction.
- Delivery format requested: you mentioned CSV + NDJSON/JSONL and preferred delivery to an EU S3 bucket (or presigned URL).

What we can deliver (proposed): 
- A 7-day sample export (January 6–12) with two slices: service-account activity and user-account activity.
- Export files: access_events.jsonl (newline-delimited JSON), access_events.csv, and an index.md describing the field schema and redaction approach.
- Redaction options: full prompt redaction, prompt_hmac (HMAC-SHA256 of prompt), or redact only PII tokens (email/SSN) — see attached redaction_spec_v1.pdf.
- Delivery options: presigned S3 (EU region) with envelope encryption (customer KMS) or password-encrypted ZIP (AES-256).

Next steps: 
1) Lindsey — confirm the exact fields and whether you want IP addresses redacted or truncated, and whether timestamps should be in UTC or in your local CET timezone.
2) Ben/Jonas — can you confirm feasibility for a sample and estimated ETA?

Thanks — I'll schedule a short follow-up for next week once Lindsey confirms.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redaction_spec_v1.pdf
From: Lindsey Carter <lindsey.carter@arcadia-fin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@arcadia-fin.com>, security@arcadia-fin.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 10:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + who-accessed export request (next steps)

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side before you build the sample: 

- Residency: exports must remain in the EU for both storage and transfer. Presigned S3 must target our EU bucket or you must deliver directly to our managed S3 endpoint.
- PII: we prefer no raw prompt text in exports. Provide prompt_hmac and optionally a redacted_prompt where PII is removed.
- IPs: truncate to /24 if possible; otherwise redact.
- Timestamps: UTC preferred.
- Retention: Arcadia needs a record of how long these logs are kept and the process to request historical exports beyond the default retention window. Specifically, what's the retention for hosted customers vs. dedicated contracts?

Also please include column-level definitions and an example row for user-initiated model calls (we need to map to our internal fields). If you can give an estimated delivery ETA for the sample (and the format), we'll route this to procurement/security.

Lindsey Carter
Head of Security & Privacy
Arcadia Financial
lindsey.carter@arcadia-fin.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Carter <lindsey.carter@arcadia-fin.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + who-accessed export request (next steps)

Hi Lindsey — happy to lay out the technical details and delivery options. Jonas added below on export schema but here are the highlights: 

1) Residency and delivery
- We can deliver the sample to an EU S3 bucket via presigned PUT/POST to your account, or we can upload to a temporary EU bucket owned by Redwood and share a presigned GET. All transfers use TLS 1.2+.
- For production exports, on Private/Dedicated we can keep the export and the runtime entirely in EU regions. Hosted customers by default store data in the region chosen at account setup (EU available).

2) Retention policy
- Hosted default: 90 days for detailed request logs, 180 days for aggregated metrics.
- Dedicated & Private: configurable retention; typical contractual term we offer is 3 years, extendable to 7 years with advance notice and additional storage fees.

3) PII handling and redaction
- We will not include raw prompt_text in the sample by default; we will provide prompt_hmac (HMAC-SHA256) and redacted_prompt when requested. Redaction logic follows the attached spec (redaction_spec_v1.pdf).
- IPs can be provided truncated (/24) or removed completely per your preference.

4) Export format and schema (summary)
- Files: access_events.jsonl (ndjson), access_events.csv (UTF-8, comma), schema_index.md (field descriptions).
- Key fields: event_id, timestamp_utc, actor_id, actor_type, user_email_hash, resource_type, action, request_id, ip_truncated, region, model, model_version, latency_ms, prompt_hmac, redacted_prompt_flag, response_size_bytes.

5) Security around delivery
- Option A (preferred): Presigned PUT to your EU S3 (customer-owned) — no copy retained in Redwood.
- Option B: Encrypted ZIP (AES-256) delivered via presigned GET with password shared over separate channel.
- Option C: Direct transfer to your SFTP over FTPS with client certs — available with Dedicated.

ETA: We can produce the 7-day sample in ~3 business days once you confirm IP handling and the exact date range. We'll include a small sample zip (~5–10 MB) and a schema index.

--
Jonas Weber (cc) — export schema and example row below.

Attachments to follow: sample_who_access_export_202601.zip (contains example files)

Regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Carter <lindsey.carter@arcadia-fin.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: Export schema + sample row (attachment)

Example schema (fields and examples)
- event_id: UUID v4 (e.g., 3f47a2c2-1d3f-4aab-b5a2-9f1d2c3b4d5e)
- timestamp_utc: 2026-01-09T14:22:08Z
- actor_id: service_12345 or user_67890
- actor_type: SERVICE / USER / ADMIN
- user_email_hash: HMAC-SHA256(email, customer_key) (we never send plain emails unless explicitly requested)
- resource_type: model, dataset, console_ui
- action: generate / embed / view / export
- request_id: request-20260109-abcdef
- ip_truncated: 198.51.100.x
- region: eu-west-1
- model: redwood-small-v1
- latency_ms: 124
- prompt_hmac: 9f8b7c... (hex)
- redacted_prompt_flag: true
- response_size_bytes: 2048

Example NDJSON row:
{"event_id":"3f47a2c2-1d3f-4aab-b5a2-9f1d2c3b4d5e","timestamp_utc":"2026-01-09T14:22:08Z","actor_id":"user_67890","actor_type":"USER","user_email_hash":"a3b1...","resource_type":"model","action":"generate","request_id":"request-20260109-abcdef","ip_truncated":"198.51.100.x","region":"eu-west-1","model":"redwood-small-v1","latency_ms":124,"prompt_hmac":"9f8b7c...","redacted_prompt_flag":true,"response_size_bytes":2048}

Note: we can additionally provide request payload Keystats (token counts) and model inference metadata if useful to your audit.

Jonas
Staff Software Engineer — Telemetry 
jonas@redwood.com
From: Lindsey Carter <lindsey.carter@arcadia-fin.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 11:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + who-accessed export request (next steps)

This looks good — thanks for the concrete schema and options. Two final asks before we mark this for procurement: 

1) Can you indicate in writing that the sample will be produced with no raw prompt_text and that user_email will be HMACed (customer secret) as described? We require that in our evidence pack.
2) Please provide an ETA for the sample delivery and a confirmation of EU-only residency for the export artifacts.

If those are confirmed, we'll queue the security review and sign the data addendum (attached draft). ETA needs to be realistic — procurement expects the sample in our hands within 5 business days.

Lindsey
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Lindsey Carter <lindsey.carter@arcadia-fin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jan 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + who-accessed export request (next steps)

Lindsey — confirmed and next steps: 

- Confirmation in writing: Redwood will produce the sample with no raw prompt_text; prompts will be represented by prompt_hmac only and a redacted_prompt_flag. User-identifying emails will be HMACed with a customer-owned secret if you provide one; otherwise Redwood will HMAC with a temporary key and indicate that in the manifest.
- Residency: export artifacts for the sample will be created and stored in EU (eu-west-1) and delivered to your EU S3 endpoint via presigned PUT. No copy will be retained in Redwood permanent object storage for the sample delivery.
- ETA: We will deliver the sample by EOD Tue, 27 Jan 2026 (3 business days). If you need it faster, we can expedite to 24–48 hours but will need explicit approval for an expedited support engagement.

Next steps for Arcadia: please confirm the date range (we propose Jan 6–12), whether you will provide a customer KMS key for envelope encryption, and whether IPs should be truncated (/24) or removed. Also please route the attached arcadia-data-addendum-draft.docx to procurement; we'll review any redlines.

I've added the HubSpot deal and a short checklist to the shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzArcadia/Arcadia-Deliverables

Thanks — Marissa

Marissa Cole
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: arcadia-data-addendum-draft.docx, sample_who_access_export_202601.zip
